svg.text: Sixteen tables. Reached only through the Cloud SQL

svg.text: connector, over TLS, with IAM — a public address

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: that accepts no direct connection.

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The map

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: One affine transform on a canvas. No map library, no

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: basemap, no third-party tile ever requested. Metres

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: from the extent corner, so nothing is reprojected.

svg.text: Resolved in the browser against the bundled index.

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: No endpoint accepts an address or a coordinate, and

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: none of it reaches storage, the URL or history.

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: and on no Iteration 1 route: AC 1.1.1 requires the

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: blockage comparison to be absent from this iteration.

svg.text: Each of the four is asked of the API first and falls back to the copy in the site container. The footer names which answered.

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: WHAT MUST STAY TRUE

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: — AD1 — no identity and no retained IP. The _Default sink excludes LOG_ID(run.googleapis.com/requests) for both services, verified with a positive control, and Cloud SQL logs no connections.

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: — No arrow points upward out of the browser. Every edge into it is a read, and no request carries anything that names a person — FORBIDDEN_WIRE_KEYS refuses sixteen such keys structurally.

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: — packages/schema holds one definition of provenance and vocabulary for the site and the API, so a decision made there cannot drift between them.
